overrides.name: Resource
overrides.reason: A Notification carries the subscribed resource in its Resource element, declared as type Resource, with xsi:type naming the actual type (see Examples/C_09_04_Notification.xml). Generate it as a value of any type derived from Resource.

overrides.name: ActiveProjectionReadingList
overrides.reason: CustomerAgreement links to it (ActiveProjectionReadingListLink), but the WADL defines no such resource. Serve it like the other active lists of the billing function set: read-only, paged.

overrides.name: ActiveTargetReadingList
overrides.reason: CustomerAgreement links to it (ActiveTargetReadingListLink), but the WADL defines no such resource. Serve it like the other active lists of the billing function set: read-only, paged.

overrides.name: ActiveCreditRegisterList
overrides.reason: Prepayment links to it (ActiveCreditRegisterListLink), but the WADL defines no such resource. Serve it like the active lists of the billing and prepayment function sets: read-only, paged.

targets.name: csipaus
targets.notes: CSIP-AUS v1.3 profiles IEEE 2030.5-2018: its schemas compile against the 2018 sep.xsd (after the RateComponentLink correction below) but not against the 2023 one, where Resource ends with an xs:any wildcard that makes ConnectionPointType non-deterministic. The Go types are generated against the 2023 schema, a superset of 2018, so that they build on the base package; csipaus/codec_test.go validates their documents against the CSIP-AUS schemas composed with the 2018 sep.xsd.

overrides.name: RateComponentLink
overrides.reason: csipaus-core-v1.3.xsd redefines TimeTariffInterval with ref="RateComponentLink", but sep.xsd declares no global element of that name, only local elements of type RateComponentLink. Treat the ref as a local element named RateComponentLink of that type.
